name: ColdChainExcursionLog
tagline: Every temperature excursion rated against its limits and stability budget – from logger alarm to QA release and CAPA.
description: A complete cold chain excursion app for 3PLs, carriers, pharma and food distributors in one Power Apps code component: rates every excursion of a shipment or reefer Minor, Major or Critical from limits, readings, duration and the shipment's cumulative time against the product's stability budget (freezing on chilled products is critical), then runs the investigation and Quality decision – root cause, disposition, send to QA, release with stability reference and four-eyes rule, reject with quantity, close with CAPA.
features: Severity from limits, duration and stability budget
Cumulative time out of range per shipment
QA release with stability reference and four-eyes rule
Reject / quarantine with quantity and value
Timeline per unit, shipment or lane
Excursion reports, bulk actions, undo, CSV export
Demo mode with a fictional cold chain network
